item.title: Dalai Lama Wins First Grammy at 90 for Spoken-Word Album on Peace and Compassion
item.description: GUWAHATI: Tibetan spiritual leader His Holiness the 14th Dalai Lama has won his first-ever Grammy Award at the age of 90 for his spoken-word album Meditations: The Reflections of His Holiness the Dalai Lama. The album secured the award in the Best Audio Book, Narration, and Storytelling Recording category at the 68th Annual Grammy Awards, held in Los Angeles, United States, on February 1, 2026.
